era: 约680-约759 : 盛唐（阳翟孤贫出身—浪迹洛阳—入宫廷为内教博士—两京寺观三百余壁画—安史乱后暮年）
era_en: c.680-c.759 : High Tang (poor orphan of Yangzhai - wandering Luoyang - Palace Erudit of the Inner Academy - three hundred walls in the two capitals - last years after the An Lushan rebellion)
school: 画圣 / 吴家样创始人 / 宗教壁画一代宗师 / 白描与疏体之祖
historical_significance: 吴道子（约680-约759），又名道玄，阳翟人，幼孤贫，浪迹洛阳，以画名召入宫廷授内教博士，玄宗更名道玄，『非有诏不得画』。一生于两京寺观作壁画三百余间，『变状阴怪』使屠沽改业，『笔才一二，像已应焉』；苏东坡断言『画至吴道子，古今之变、天下之能事毕矣』。他完成了中国人物画由密体向疏体的转向：兰叶描的线条动力学、目识心记的默写创作、借裴旻舞剑的借势起兴、守神专一的心法、焦墨微染的吴装、只钩不放的环节拆分、程式生成的吴家样、地狱变相的视觉劝诫、不签一纸的匿名策略、身后托付的人事布局——共同构成一个以『把不可见的势，画进可传世的线』为核心的完整思想体系。张彦远《历代名画记》以其为『古今独步，前不见顾陆，后无来者』。
historical_significance_en: Wu Daozi (c.680-c.759), also named Daoxuan, a poor orphan of Yangzhai who wandered to Luoyang, was summoned to court for his painting as Palace Erudit of the Inner Academy—renamed Daoxuan by Xuanzong and forbidden to paint without imperial order. Across his life he painted mural after mural in more than three hundred temple and monastery halls of the two capitals; his 'states of dark strangeness' made butchers change their trades, and 'two or three strokes of the brush and the image answered.' Su Shi declared that 'when painting reached Wu Daozi, the changes of past and present and the utmost of all skill under heaven were complete.' He accomplished the turn of Chinese figure painting from the dense manner to the spare: the line dynamics of the orchid-leaf stroke, memory-recall creation with no drafts, borrowed momentum from General Pei's sword-dance, the mind-method of guarding the spirit and unifying the one, the charred-ink light wash of the Wu finish, the stage-splitting of line-only and delegated color, the manner-as-generator of the Wu school style, the visual moral pressure of the Hell Transformation, the unsigned-master strategy, and the entrust-the-afterlife succession in personnel—together a complete system of thought with 'painting the invisible momentum into transmissible line' at its core. Zhang Yanyuan's Record of Famous Painters ranked him 'unique across all ages: before him no Gu or Lu; after him, none.'
unique_thinking: 别人画画是把看见的抄下来，吴道子是把看不见的画出来：风没有形状，他画衣带；地狱没有形状，他画屠夫放下刀的手——他不复制世界，他给世界缺少的那部分力找到一个可以存活的载体。
unique_thinking_en: Others copy what they see; Wu painted what cannot be seen: wind has no shape, so he painted the sashes; hell has no shape, so he painted the butcher's hand laying down the knife—he did not duplicate the world; he found a vessel in which the force the world was missing could survive.
roles_zh: 浪迹洛阳的民间画工（早年）
两京寺观壁画首席画师
roles_en: Wandering artisan painter of Luoyang (early years)
Palace Erudit of the Inner Academy, Inner Attendant
Chief muralist of the temple walls of the two capitals
Sage of Painting; founding master of the Wu manner
key_works: 《八十七神仙卷》（传派白描粉本）
《嘉陵江三百里山水》（大同殿壁，已毁）
两京寺观三百余间壁画（多毁于会昌灭佛）

modes.domain_zh: 让衣纹线条本身携带风的运动——用圆转飘逸、宽窄随势变化的兰叶描，把布料的下垂感改写成飞扬感；观者看静止的壁画却感到衣带在风里飘举，线条由轮廓升格为独立的运动载体
modes.domain_en: Make the drapery line itself carry the motion of wind—with rounded, airborne, width-varying orchid-leaf strokes, rewrite the downward weight of cloth into upward flight; viewers of a still mural feel the sashes floating in a breeze, and the line is promoted from boundary to independent vehicle of movement
modes.definition_zh: 郭若虚《图画见闻志》记『吴带当风，曹衣出水』：曹仲达的笔法让衣服贴身如出水，吴道子的笔法让衣服腾空如临风。这一对术语背后是一整套线条动力学的选择：其一，线不是轮廓而是主角——前人用线框住形，吴道子用线生成形；衣纹的每一条描线都有起点、行进、收束的完整运动史，宽窄提按随肌肉与风力变化，故后世称之为兰叶描或莼菜条。其二，把不可画的对象画出来——风无形，但风的作用有形；不去描摹风的形状，而去放大风的效应（飘举的衣带、倾侧的幡、后掠的鬚发），让观者由果推因感到风的存在。其三，速度注入线条——吴带当风的本质是线中有速度，行笔快而不滑、转处圆而不断，静态壁画因此获得了演奏性。深意在于：表现不可见之物，不靠添加可见符号，而靠扭曲可见之物的受力方式——这是整个中国人物画由『以形写神』走向『以线生势』的枢纽。代价是：飘逸线质依赖极深的腕底童功，速度一旦失控线条即瘫软如面条；且飞扬风格一旦成为套路，便会滑向千壁一律的飘。现代对应物是动作漫画的速度线、字体设计中字重的呼吸感、以及一切『让静态媒介携带运动信息』的技艺。
modes.definition_en: Guo Ruoxu's Notes on What Painting Has Heard and Seen canonized the pair: 'Cao's robes cling like one emergent from water; Wu's sashes move as if in wind.' Cao Zhongda's line makes cloth hug the body; Wu Daozi's line makes cloth soar. Behind the pairing lies a whole choice of line dynamics. First, the line is not contour but protagonist: predecessors used line to enclose form, Wu used line to generate it; every drapery stroke has a complete history of departure, travel and finish, thickening and thinning with muscle and wind—the later orchid-leaf stroke, the water-shoot stroke. Second, paint the unpaintable: wind has no shape, but its effects do; do not depict wind's shape—amplify wind's consequences (lifted sashes, tilting banners, swept-back beards), and let viewers infer the wind from the fruit. Third, inject speed into the line: the essence of Wu's wind-borne bands is velocity inside the stroke—fast without slipping, turning without breaking—so a still mural acquires performance. The deeper point: to render the invisible, do not add visible symbols; distort how the visible is loaded with force—the hinge by which Chinese figure painting moved from 'spirit through form' to 'momentum through line.' The cost: airborne line quality demands decades of wrist discipline; speed gone slack collapses into noodles; and once flight becomes a formula it degrades into a thousand identical winds. Modern analogues: motion lines in comics, the breathing weight of typefaces, and every craft that makes static media carry movement.
modes.source_chapter: 郭若虚《图画见闻志》『曹衣出水，吴带当风』；张彦远《历代名画记》论吴道玄用笔
key_concepts: 不可见之物的效应放大
modes.key_quote_zh: 吴带当风——线不是衣服的边界，线就是风。
modes.key_quote_en: Wu's sashes move in wind—the line is not the border of the cloth; the line is the wind.
process_zh: 选受力点：为每一片衣料先判定风向与受力来源，明确这片布此刻在受什么力、往哪里飞
起线即赋速：起笔以藏锋蓄势、行笔立即加速，让第一段线就带出运动的方向感
随势变宽窄：提按随布料的拉扯与垂落实时变化，兰叶般的宽窄波动替代均匀铁线
收线留风势：收笔不封闭不回描，让每条线的末端仍带着未尽的运动惯性，整壁衣纹互相鼓荡
process_en: Choose the force point: for each panel of cloth, first decide the wind's direction and origin—what force this fabric is under and where it flies
Load speed at departure: start with a hidden-tip gathering of force, then accelerate at once, so the first segment already carries direction
Vary width with momentum: modulate pressure in real time with cloth's pull and drape; let orchid-leaf undulations replace the uniform iron wire
End with wind left in it: close without sealing or retouching, so every line's tail still holds unspent momentum and the whole wall of drapery swells together
representative_cases_zh: 《八十七神仙卷》（传吴道子派）长卷：八十七位神仙的衣带全部向同一气口飘举，三十米长卷无一处风势中断，是吴带当风的教科书样本
《送子天王图》：鬼神力士的衣纹在剧烈转折处用最宽的兰叶描承接重量，飘举处反收细——力量与风势在同一人物身上分层
《历代名画记》记吴道子画兴善寺门神，『笔才一二，像已应焉』，长安老幼士庶竞至——线条的动势本身就是公共事件
反例警示：后世描摹吴样者只学飘举的姿态而不受力学，衣带飘得毫无风向，如塑料条挂在展柜里——没有受力分析的飘逸是对飘逸的抄袭
representative_cases_en: The Eighty-Seven Celestials scroll (Wu-school tradition): the sashes of all eighty-seven divine figures stream toward one breath, thirty continuous meters without a break in the wind—the textbook specimen
Birth of Guanyin as the Heavenly King's Son: at violent turns, the broadest orchid-leaf stroke bears the weight of muscular drapery, while flying panels thin out—force and wind layered on one body

Record of Famous Painters of All Ages: painting the door gods of Xingxing Temple, 'the brush had made two strokes and the image answered'—crowds of Chang'an gathered, the line's momentum itself a public event

Counter-case: later imitators copied the flight without the mechanics, sashes airborne with no wind-direction at all, like plastic ribbons in a display case—drift without force analysis is plagiarism of flight
modern_applications_zh: 动画与游戏原画：用受力分析替代姿势临摹——先为角色每一块布料写下『受什么风』，再动笔
产品与视觉设计：让静态版面携带动势——标题字重、留白方向、图形倾角统一指向一个虚构的风向
演讲与写作：给文章设计『兰叶描』句式——句子的宽窄（长短句）随论证的受力起伏变化，避免均质长句的铁线感
品牌识别：选定一个『飘举方向』作为视觉母题，让所有物料在同一风里飘
modern_applications_en: Animation and game concept art: replace pose-copying with force analysis—write down 'what wind this cloth is under' for every panel before drawing
Product and visual design: let a static layout carry momentum—headline weight, whitespace direction and graphic tilt all point to one invented wind
Speaking and writing: design orchid-leaf sentence rhythm—sentence length swells and thins with the argument's load, avoiding the iron-wire monotony of uniform clauses
Brand identity: choose one direction of flight as the visual motif, and let all materials drift in the same wind

modes.domain_zh: 现场不写生、不带粉本，只看——把嘉陵江三百里山水收进记忆，回宫后一日而毕；以记忆为滤镜过滤掉杂讯，只留下结构性的大势，让创作成为从心里取出而非从眼前抄下
modes.domain_en: Do not sketch on site or carry a draft—only look: swallow three hundred li of Jialing River landscape into memory, and finish the wall in one day back at court; memory acts as a filter that discards noise and keeps structural essentials, so creation becomes an extraction from the mind, not a copy from the eye
modes.definition_zh: 《唐朝名画录》载：玄宗遣吴道子写嘉陵江山水，还朝问状，答曰『臣无粉本，并记在心』，遂于大同殿一日而毕；对照李思训累月方毕，玄宗评『李思训数月之功，吴道子一日之迹，皆极其妙』。方法论内核有三：其一，现场的任务是摄入不是记录——对景写生会把注意力耗在描摹细节上，目识心记则逼着眼睛做结构化压缩：山势的来龙去脉、水口的转折、气象的开合，被提炼为可携带的心象。其二，记忆是主动的取舍机制——忘不掉的不是全部而是骨架，杂树、行人、偶然光影在转存中自然脱落；默写出来的作品因此比写生更『像嘉陵江』，因为它是嘉陵江的本质而非某一处嘉陵江。其三，一日而毕是压缩的直接兑现——因为创作时不再有『对照』环节，笔笔从胸中流出，速度反而成为质量的证明。深意在于：真正可靠的观察以遗忘为成品——看过而能忘掉 ninety percent 的人，才留住了可以调用的十 percent。代价是：默写依赖海量样板积累，无根基的心记只是空想；且『记在心』的表述容易被滥用为拒绝做功课的借口。现代对应物是费曼式闭卷推导、战地记者回旅馆才写的稿、以及一切『先深度摄入再离开现场输出』的工作流。
modes.definition_en: Annals of Famous Painters of the Tang: Emperor Xuanzong sent Wu Daozi to render the Jialing River; asked on return for his drafts, he replied, 'I have no drafts—it is all stored in my heart,' and finished the Datong Hall wall in one day—against Li Sixun's months of labor, prompting the emperor: 'Li's months and Wu's single day—both reach the utmost.' The method has three cores. First, on site the task is intake, not recording: sketching from life spends attention on tracing particulars, while eye-capture forces the eye into structured compression—the ancestry and trend of mountains, the turns of waters, the opening and closing of atmosphere, distilled into portable mental images. Second, memory is an active editorial mechanism: what one cannot forget is not everything but the skeleton; incidental trees, travelers, accidental light fall away in transfer—so the painting from memory is more like the Jialing than any sketch, being its essence rather than some spot of it. Third, the one-day completion is the compression cashed out: with no 'collation' stage, every stroke flows from the chest, and speed becomes proof of quality. The deeper point: trustworthy observation has forgetting as its product—only one who can forget ninety percent has retained the ten percent that can be summoned. The cost: recall-painting rests on vast prior stock; mind-recall without foundation is mere fantasy, and 'stored in my heart' is easily abused as an excuse to skip the work. Modern analogues: closed-book Feynman derivation, the war correspondent writing only back at the hotel, every workflow of deep intake followed by output away from the scene.
modes.source_chapter: 朱景玄《唐朝名画录》嘉陵江三百里『臣无粉本，并记在心』；一日而毕 vs 李思训数月之功
modes.key_quote_zh: 臣无粉本，并记在心——现场负责摄入，创作负责取出，两个阶段必须分开。
modes.key_quote_en: I have no drafts—it is stored in my heart: the field does the intake, creation does the extraction; the two stages must be kept apart.
process_zh: 空手赴场：明确宣布此行不带速写本，逼眼睛进入『看了就要负责记住』的高压模式
结构优先扫描：按『大势—骨架—气象』三级顺序过一遍对象，主动放弃可查证的细节
离场冷却：离开现场后再动笔，让遗忘自然完成杂讯过滤，只余结构心象
一气默写：动笔后不回现场核对，从记忆直接输出成品，用完成速度检验压缩质量
process_en: Arrive empty-handed: declare in advance that no sketchbook comes along, forcing the eye into high-pressure mode—'what you see, you must answer for'
Scan by structure first: pass over the subject in three tiers—grand trend, skeleton, atmosphere—deliberately surrendering verifiable detail
Cool off away from the scene: begin work only after leaving, letting forgetting finish its noise-filtering and leave the structural image
Write out in one breath: never return to verify; output the finished work straight from memory, testing compression quality by completion speed
representative_cases_zh: 嘉陵江三百里一日毕：与李思训累月之功同殿并悬而两极其妙——默写与写生在皇帝面前同台竞技且互不逊色
《历代名画记》记其画大同殿壁『嘉陵江三百里……一日之迹』，玄宗叹『此画于朕面前图之』——创作被验证为无需现场的可迁移能力
长安寺院数十堵壁画经变：佛教经变的庞杂叙事全靠心记组织，一壁之内数百人物各有来历而不乱
反例警示：无根基者模仿『记在心』，现场不走心、回来想不起，只好编造——没有摄入量的默写是虚构不是创作
representative_cases_en: Three hundred li of the Jialing in one day: hung beside Li Sixun's months of labor on the same hall, both judged to reach the utmost—memory-painting and life-painting competing before the emperor without a loser

Record of Famous Painters: the Jialing wall at Datong Hall, 'the traces of one day,' with the emperor marveling that it was rendered as if before his eyes—creation validated as a transferable skill needing no site

Dozens of transformation-tableau walls in Chang'an temples: vast Buddhist narratives organized entirely by trained recall—hundreds of figures on one wall, each with its provenance and none in disorder
Counter-case: the unfounded imitator of 'stored in my heart' neither attends on site nor remembers on return, and simply invents—recall without intake is fiction, not creation
modern_applications_zh: 会议与访谈：全程不做笔记，事后立刻闭卷复述结构——记忆压缩逼出真正听懂的部分
学习与考试：读书后合书推导，而非翻书划线——用默写检验理解，用遗忘筛选重点
产品调研：现场只看不记，回到工位先凭记忆写用户旅程——偶然细节脱落，核心痛点浮出
演讲训练：不用提词器的唯一可靠路径是结构化记忆，不是逐字背诵
modern_applications_en: Meetings and interviews: take no notes; immediately afterwards, closed-book reconstruction of the structure—compression forces out what was truly understood
Study and exams: close the book and derive, don't highlight—recall tests understanding; forgetting selects the essentials
User research: watch on site, record nothing; back at the desk, first write the user journey from memory—incidental details drop out, core pain surfaces
Public speaking: the only reliable path to going prompter-free is structured memory, not word-for-word memorization

modes.domain_zh: 画前主动引入一个剧烈的外部事件为创作蓄能——请裴旻将军舞剑：剑舞的猛厉节奏灌进画笔，『庶因猛厉以通幽冥』；用身体性的仪式把自己推进到画面需要的能量层级，再落笔
modes.domain_en: Before painting, deliberately introduce a violent external event to charge the work—inviting General Pei Min to dance the sword: the fierce rhythm of the blade pours into the brush, 'that through fierceness one may reach the dark and unseen'; use a bodily ritual to raise yourself to the energy level the image requires, then set brush to wall
modes.definition_zh: 《唐朝名画录》载：裴旻母丧，请吴道子于天宫寺画神鬼壁以资冥福，并驰马舞剑以谢。吴道子封还金帛，独请曰：『废画已久，若将军有意，为予缠结舞剑一曲，庶因猛厉以通幽冥。』裴旻舞剑毕，吴道子奋笔俄顷而成，『有若神助』。方法论内核有三：其一，创作状态不是等来的而是制造出来的——吴道子不假装自己随时有灵感，而是坦承『废画已久』，并主动设计一个把自己重新点燃的仪式。其二，选择与作品同构的激发源——为猛厉的神鬼壁选择舞剑而非饮酒或听琴，激发事件的能量质感必须匹配目标作品的能量质感；剑的劈刺节奏预先排练进了笔的劈刺节奏。其三，激发是跳板不是内容——剑舞不进入画面，画面里没有一把剑；它只负责把作者推到临界态，作品本身仍从腕底自发生成。深意在于：高手对创作燃料的诚实——承认状态有电量、并且为充电设计专门程序，比装作永不断电更专业。代价是：仪式会形成依赖，离开特定激发源就启动失败；且激发产生的势能若不能即刻转化为落笔，会白白耗散。现代对应物是运动员的赛前热身程序、乐手开演前的调音仪式、以及一切『用身体事件改变大脑状态』的启动法。
modes.definition_en: Annals of Famous Painters of the Tang: General Pei Min, mourning his mother, asked Wu to paint a wall of spirits at Tiangong Temple for the dead's blessing, offering horseback sword-dance in thanks. Wu returned the gold and silk and asked only: 'My brush has long been idle—if the general is willing, dance the sword once for me, that through its fierceness I may reach the dark and unseen.' When the dance ended, Wu took up the brush and finished in moments, 'as if aided by a spirit.' Three cores. First, the creative state is manufactured, not awaited: Wu does not pretend inspiration is always on call—he admits 'my brush has long been idle' and designs a ritual to relight himself. Second, choose a stimulant isomorphic with the work: for a wall of fierce spirits he picks the sword-dance, not wine or the qin—the energy texture of the trigger must match the energy texture of the target; the blade's chop-and-thrust is rehearsed into the brush's chop-and-thrust. Third, the trigger is a springboard, not content: no sword enters the painting; it only pushes the maker to critical state, and the work still generates from the wrist. The deeper point: the master's honesty about creative fuel—admitting the state has a battery and writing a charging procedure for it is more professional than pretending never to black out. The cost: ritual breeds dependence—away from the trigger, ignition fails; and momentum not converted into immediate strokes dissipates. Modern analogues: the athlete's warm-up protocol, the musician's tuning ritual, every ignition method that changes the brain's state through a bodily event.
modes.source_chapter: 朱景玄《唐朝名画录》：请裴旻舞剑『庶因猛厉以通幽冥』，奋笔俄顷而成，有若神助
modes.key_quote_zh: 为予缠结舞剑一曲，庶因猛厉以通幽冥——不等灵感，亲手设计点燃自己的仪式。
modes.key_quote_en: Dance the sword once for me, that through its fierceness I may reach the unseen—do not wait for inspiration; build the ritual that lights you.
process_zh: 承认电量：动笔前诚实评估自己的创作状态，明确承认『废画已久』而不是硬写
选定同构激发源：按目标作品的能量质感（猛厉/沉静/戏谑）挑选对应的身体性事件
全情参与仪式：以观众兼受能者的身份完整经历激发事件，不做旁观者
临界即落笔：激发结束的瞬间立即转笔，不给势能冷却的间隙，一鼓作气完成主体
process_en: Admit the charge level: before beginning, honestly assess your creative state and admit 'the brush has long been idle' rather than grinding anyway
Pick an isomorphic trigger: select a bodily event whose energy texture—fierce, calm, playful—matches the target work's
Undergo the ritual wholly: experience the trigger as participant and receiver of energy, never as a bystander
Strike at critical moment: the instant the trigger ends, take up the brush—no gap for momentum to cool; finish the body of the work in one surge
representative_cases_zh: 天宫寺神鬼壁：裴旻舞剑毕而吴道子奋笔俄顷，时人谓『道子平生画迹，唯此得神助』——借势创作的最完整记录
封还金帛的细节：他谢绝了酬金只收一场剑舞——明确把『激发事件』定价为比钱更贵的创作资源
张旭观剑舞而草书大进、怀素闻嘉陵涛声而笔势益壮——同一时代多人共享『以武入艺』的借势传统，吴道子是其枢纽
反例警示：只学仪式不学转化的人，看尽猛厉场景回到画前依然平庸——激发若不通向即刻的笔，只是娱乐
representative_cases_en: The Tiangong Temple spirit-wall: the sword-dance ends, the brush flashes, the wall stands in moments—contemporaries said of all Wu's works only this one 'had the aid of a spirit': the fullest record of borrowed momentum
Returning the gold and silk: he declined payment and accepted only one sword-dance—pricing the 'trigger event' explicitly as a creative resource dearer than money
Zhang Xu's cursive advancing after watching swordplay, Huaisu's brush swelling at the sound of the Jialing rapids—a whole era sharing the 'enter art through force' tradition, with Wu at its hinge
Counter-case: those who copy the ritual but not the conversion watch every fierce scene and still paint mediocre walls—excitation that does not flow instantly into the brush is mere entertainment
modern_applications_zh: 深度工作启动：为不同类型的任务各设计一个固定『起手仪式』（音乐/体式/冲刺），把进入状态从玄学变成程序
团队冲刺：项目启动日用一场高强度的现场演示或用户见面会作为集体激发源，再立刻进入开发
写作节奏：长文开写前先做十分钟与文章气质同构的输入（读一段对应文体的巅峰文本）再落笔
健身与技能训练：把『热身』从防伤程序升格为状态制造程序——热身的终点是手感临界点而非体温达标
modern_applications_en: Deep-work ignition: design a fixed opening ritual per task type—music, posture, a sprint—turning 'getting into state' from mysticism into procedure
Team sprints: open a project cycle with one intense live demo or user meeting as collective trigger, then code immediately
Writing rhythm: before a long piece, ten minutes of isomorphic input—a peak text in the target genre—then write
Training and fitness: upgrade warm-up from injury prevention to state manufacture—warm up to the tipping point of feel, not merely of body temperature

modes.domain_zh: 张彦远记吴道子论画：『守其神，专其一，合造化之功，假吴生之笔』——作画时把全部神志收拢为一，让手成为造化的临时通道；技术准备在平时完成，临场只做一件事：不容任何杂念分走神志
modes.domain_en: Zhang Yanyuan records Wu's words on painting: 'Guard the spirit, unify the one, join the work of creation, borrow the brush of Wu'—at the wall, gather all consciousness into one and let the hand become creation's temporary channel; technique is banked in ordinary days, and on the spot only one thing remains: let no stray thought take any of the spirit
modes.definition_zh: 《历代名画记·论顾陆张吴用笔》：『守其神，专其一，合造化之功，假吴生之笔。向所谓意存笔先，画尽意在也。』方法论内核有三：其一，神志是唯一不可再生的创作资源——笔墨可以再蘸、粉本可以再起，但落笔瞬间的专注一旦被切割，线条立刻出现犹豫的痕迹；所以临场的全部纪律只有一条：守住它。其二，『专其一』是排他性的单一焦点——不是兼顾构图与笔法与内容的分神式多线程，而是在落笔前把三者预演整合为一个完整意念，落笔时只执行这一个『一』。其三，合造化之功是让自我退场——专注的极致不是『我很专注』的自我意识，而是自我意识消失、只剩画面自己在生成；『假吴生之笔』的说法把自己降格为工具，恰是深度心流的古典表述。深意在于：意存笔先与守神专一是同一件事的两半——事前的整合越完整，临场需要守住的东西就越简单。代价是：这种全收式的专注不可久持，只能以段落式爆发使用；且高度专注下容错率趋零，一旦被惊扰整段状态作废。现代对应物是深度工作的注意力管理、冥想传统的收摄根门、以及运动员所说的『the zone』。
modes.definition_en: Record of Famous Painters, 'On the Brush of Gu, Lu, Zhang and Wu': 'Guard the spirit, unify the one, join the work of creation, borrow the brush of Wu. This is what was meant by intent before the brush and meaning enduring when the painting ends.' Three cores. First, consciousness is the only nonrenewable creative resource: ink can be re-dipped, drafts redrawn, but the instant of the stroke, once divided, bears hesitation in the line forever—so the whole discipline on the spot is one rule: guard it. Second, 'unify the one' is a single exclusive focus: not distracted multi-tasking across composition, brush and content, but a pre-integrated complete intention rehearsed before the stroke, so that at the moment of execution only this 'one' runs. Third, joining creation's work is the self's exit: the extreme of focus is not the self-awareness of being focused but the disappearance of self-awareness, only the image generating itself; calling himself 'the brush Wu borrows' demotes the artist to instrument—the classical statement of deep flow. The deeper point: intent-before-brush and guard-the-spirit are two halves of one thing—the more complete the prior integration, the simpler what must be guarded on the spot. The cost: total-gather focus cannot be sustained; it works in burst segments, and under such focus error tolerance approaches zero—one alarm voids the whole state. Modern analogues: attention management in deep work, the meditative gathering of the senses, what athletes call the zone.
modes.source_chapter: 张彦远《历代名画记·论顾陆张吴用笔》『守其神，专其一』『意存笔先，画尽意在』
modes.key_quote_zh: 守其神，专其一，合造化之功，假吴生之笔——临场只做一件事：不让任何杂念分走神志。
modes.key_quote_en: Guard the spirit, unify the one, join creation's work, borrow the brush of Wu—on the spot, one duty only: let no stray thought take any of the spirit.
process_zh: 赛前整合：落笔前把构图、笔法、内容预演为一个完整意念，把『要决定的事』全部清零在前
设界闭关：宣布作画时段不可打扰（挡驾、屏客、关户），为专注建物理与社交边界
收摄为一：动笔时只保留一个念头在场，其余自我意识（我画得好吗、别人怎么看）全部逐出
段落式爆发：把长工程切成若干个全神时段，段间彻底休息，不假装可以全天维持临界态
process_en: Pre-integrate: rehearse composition, brush and content into one complete intention before the stroke; zero out all 'decisions pending' in advance
Set the boundary: declare the painting window untouchable—turn visitors away, shut the door; build physical and social walls for focus
Gather to one: at the brush keep a single thought present; expel every other self-awareness (am I doing well, how does this look)
Burst in segments: cut long projects into fully-charged intervals with real rest between; do not pretend the critical state can last all day
representative_cases_zh: 『守其神，专其一』被张彦远置于顾陆张吴用笔论的顶点——它不是技法而是所有技法运转的前提条件
景公寺《地狱变相》'笔力劲怒'的记载：大型壁画的连续数日创作要求段落式全神，交接点误差累积为零
吴道子 refusing 敷彩、令弟子翟琙、张藏布色：把有限的全神预算全部花在用笔上，填色交给可信的执行者
反例警示：边画边应酬、边画边聊的画工，线条永远带着分神的毛刺——神守不住，形再准也是死的
representative_cases_en: 'Guard the spirit, unify the one' stands at the summit of Zhang Yanyuan's essay on the four masters' brush—not a technique but the precondition of all techniques running
The Hell Transformation at Jinggong Temple recorded with 'brush-force stern and wrathful': mural-scale work over many days demands segmented full-focus, with zero error accumulated at the handoffs
Wu's refusal to do his own coloring, delegating fills to disciples Zhai Cong and Zhang Cang: spend the finite full-focus budget wholly on the brush; give color to trusted executors
Counter-case: the painter who chats and receives guests mid-stroke carries the burr of distraction in every line—spirit unguarded, form exact yet dead
modern_applications_zh: 深度工作排程：把每天最重要的创造性任务放进 1-2 个不可打扰的『守神段』，其余事务性工作填充段外
会议纪律：决策会不做两件事——既不边讨论边写文档，也不接受中途打断；每会只有一个『一』
创作协作分工：核心创作者只守最需要临界态的环节（如架构/关键笔），可交接的执行果断下放
休息管理：高专注段之间安排真正的离线恢复，而不是刷手机式的假休息
modern_applications_en: Schedule for deep work: place the day's most creative task in one or two untouchable 'guard-the-spirit' blocks; fill the rest with clerical work
Meeting discipline: decide never to do two things in a decision meeting—no writing documents while discussing, no mid-meeting interruptions; one 'one' per meeting
Collaborative division: the core creator guards only the stage that demands critical state (architecture, the decisive strokes); hand off everything executable
Recovery management: between high-focus segments schedule real offline rest, not the fake rest of scrolling

modes.domain_zh: 『傅彩于焦墨痕中，略施微染，自然超出缣素』——用骨线承担全部表现力，颜色只做克制的辅助微染；设色从主角降为配菜，反而让作品『超出缣素』，在满壁重彩的唐代独树一帜
modes.domain_en: 'Color applied within the charred-ink lines, lightly washed, naturally rising above the silk'—let the bone-line carry all expressive power while color only assists with restrained tints; demote color from protagonist to garnish, and the work 'rises above the silk,' unique on Tang walls crowded with heavy pigment
modes.definition_zh: 《图画见闻志》论『吴装』：焦墨痕中略施微染。方法论内核有三：其一，表现力的主承重结构是线不是色——吴道子把笔墨训练的全部预算投入骨线，设色只负责把线衬出来；这使作品在褪色、剥落后的残壁上依然完整——线在则画在。其二，节制是有意的竞争策略——唐寺院壁画以重彩斗富，吴装以素取胜，满壁金碧中间的一堵素壁反而获得最高的辨识度；审美差异化本身就是注意力策略。其三，微染不是不用色而是色为线服务——淡赭与淡彩的微染让焦墨线的边缘微微发暖，观者感到线条『活』而不觉颜色『多』。深意在于：减法必须有替代性的承重结构——只做减法是空洞，先建一条足以独挑大梁的线，减色才是风格而不是缺陷。代价是：素装把全部赌注压在骨线质量上，线弱则全盘皆输；且在重彩传统里坚持素装需要极强的定力与身份自信。现代对应物是单色系品牌设计、铅笔手稿直接出版、以及一切『用一个强元素替代全套修饰』的表达策略。
modes.definition_en: Notes on What Painting Has Heard and Seen on the 'Wu finish': color laid lightly within charred-ink lines. Three cores. First, the load-bearing structure of expressiveness is line, not color: Wu spent his entire training budget on the bone-line, color only setting the line off—so on walls faded and flaked the work remains whole: where the line survives, the painting survives. Second, restraint is a deliberate competitive strategy: Tang temple walls competed in heavy pigment; the Wu finish won by plainness—one unadorned wall among walls of gold and green-blue earns the highest recognizability; aesthetic differentiation is itself an attention strategy. Third, the light wash is not the absence of color but color serving line: pale ochre warms the charred edge just enough that viewers feel the line 'alive' without feeling the color 'many.' The deeper point: subtraction requires a substitute load-bearing structure—subtraction alone is emptiness; build first a line that can carry the roof alone, and then thin color becomes style, not deficiency. The cost: the plain finish stakes everything on bone-line quality—weak line, total loss; and holding plainness inside a heavy-color tradition demands iron discipline and identity confidence. Modern analogues: monochrome brand systems, publishing pencil drafts as-is, every strategy that replaces the full set of ornaments with one strong element.
modes.source_chapter: 郭若虚《图画见闻志》论曹吴体法与『吴装』；『浅深晕成……傅彩于焦墨痕中略施微染』
modes.key_quote_zh: 傅彩于焦墨痕中，略施微染，自然超出缣素——线扛住一切，颜色才有资格克制。
modes.key_quote_en: Color within the charred-ink lines, lightly washed—the work rises above the silk; only a line that can carry everything has earned the right to restrain its color.
process_zh: 先建承重线：把主要精力投入骨线的质量与表现力，确认它离开颜色也能独立成立
定色为辅原则：为作品明确写下『颜色只许做什么』（衬线/暖边/分区），禁止它抢叙事
微染执行：设色分多层极淡进行，永远停在『再浓一格就抢线』的临界之前
褪色测试：想象或模拟颜料全部剥落后作品的存续状态——若线网仍完整，吴装成立
process_en: Build the load-bearing line first: invest primary effort in the bone-line's quality until it stands without color
Write the color charter: state exactly what color is allowed to do (set off line, warm edges, zone the field) and forbid it from seizing narrative
Execute in faint layers: apply color in many ultra-light passes, always stopping just before the tint would outshout the line
The fading test: imagine or simulate all pigment flaked away—if the web of lines still holds, the Wu finish stands
representative_cases_zh: 『吴装』成为独立术语进入画学史：一种设色方式被命名，说明它不是省略而是完整的方法论
传世吴派白描粉本（如《八十七神仙卷》纯线版本）本身即是完整作品——颜色缺席处恰是线的自主性证明
后世李公麟专发展白描一科成『白描大宗』——吴装提供的减法路径被后人走成了独立画科
反例警示：骨线未立就谈素雅的画者，作品苍白而非素净——没有承重结构的减色只是没画完
representative_cases_en: 'Wu finish' entering art history as a named term: a manner of coloring earns a name only when it is a complete methodology, not an omission
Surviving Wu-school baimiao drafts (the pure-line version of the Eighty-Seven Celestials) standing as complete works—the absence of color is precisely the proof of the line's autonomy
Li Gonglin later founding the baimiao school outright on this path: the subtraction route Wu opened became an independent genre
Counter-case: those who preach plainness before the bone-line stands produce pallor, not plainness—thinned color without a load-bearing structure is just an unfinished painting
modern_applications_zh: 品牌与界面设计：先做单色原型验证结构与层次，通过后再决定是否引入颜色——色彩是奖励不是依赖
写作：先写纯文字版通顺立骨，再考虑图表与排版修饰；骨架立不住的稿子加图只是遮丑
产品功能：核心功能未达独撑大梁的质量前，克制加功能的冲动——功能堆砌会掩盖核心空洞
个人表达：选定一个强元素（文风/声音/视觉签名）练到独挑大梁，其余装饰全部最小化
modern_applications_en: Brand and interface design: validate structure and hierarchy in monochrome first; introduce color only after it passes—color as reward, not dependency
Writing: finish a clean text-only draft that stands on its bones before adding charts and layout; images over a weak skeleton are cosmetics on a ruin
Product scope: before the core feature can carry the product alone, resist feature-adding—stacked features mask a hollow core
Personal expression: pick one strong element—prose voice, sound, visual signature—and train it to carry the roof alone; minimize all other ornament

modes.domain_zh: 壁画收尾『立笔挥扫，势若风旋』而终不肯完成敷彩——让弟子翟琙、张藏布色；把创作拆为不可让渡的核心环节（骨线/构图）与可让渡的执行环节（填色），自己只做别人做不了的那一段
modes.domain_en: Finishing a mural 'sweeping the brush like a whirl of wind' yet refusing to lay the colors—letting disciples Zhai Cong and Zhang Cang fill them: split creation into the non-delegable core (bone-line, composition) and the delegable execution (coloring); do only the segment no one else can do
modes.definition_zh: 《历代名画记》记吴道子画壁多『使得翟琙、张藏布色』，张藏『每图一变像……经岁落成』；而吴本人『立笔挥扫，势若风旋，人皆谓之神助』后即止。方法论内核有三：其一，识别创作链的承重环节——在吴道子的体系里，骨线与构图承载全部艺术判断，填色在『吴装』体系下被降格为可规格化的工序；他拒绝把有限的全神预算摊薄到可让渡的环节。其二，让渡不是甩手而是授权设计——弟子布色仍需经得起『焦墨痕中微染』的规范约束，色不许越过线；交接界面被严格定义，风格完整性不因分工而稀释。其三，规模由此成为可能——一人一臂难以在数年间覆盖长安数十寺的巨量壁画需求，环节拆分让『吴家样』成为可复制的生产体系而非孤本绝技；这正是画史上『样』（样式可传承）概念的实践起源之一。深意在于：对个人稀缺性最清醒的经营是把不可复制的那部分做到极致、把可复制的那部分标准化交出——大师的生产力不在于事必躬亲，而在于画工与画匠的分界设计。代价是：让渡环节的质量波动由大师的名字兜底，弟子失手即是『吴道子』的失手；且长期不亲执行的环节，自己的手感也会钝化。现代对应物是建筑师画方案图而把施工图交给事务所、主笔作者与合著者、以及一切创意产业的『核心创作者+执行团队』结构。
modes.definition_en: Record of Famous Painters notes that Wu's walls were often colored by disciples Zhai Cong and Zhang Cang—the latter 'completing a transformation figure over the space of a year'—while Wu himself, after 'sweeping the brush like a whirlwind, all calling it spirit-aid,' simply stopped. Three cores. First, identify the load-bearing links in the chain of creation: in Wu's system the bone-line and composition carry all artistic judgment, while under the 'Wu finish' coloring is downgraded to a specifiable process; he refuses to spread his finite full-focus budget across delegable stages. Second, delegation is not abandonment but authorization design: the disciples' color must still obey the charter of 'light wash within charred-ink lines,' color never crossing the line; the handoff interface is strictly defined, so style survives the division of labor. Third, scale thereby becomes possible: one pair of arms cannot cover the wall-demands of dozens of Chang'an temples across years; stage-splitting made the 'Wu manner' a replicable production system rather than a one-off miracle—among the practical origins of the art-historical concept of the 'manner' (yang) as inheritable. The deeper point: the clearest way to manage one's own scarcity is to perfect the non-replicable part and standardize-and-hand-over the replicable—a master's productivity lies not in doing everything but in designing the border between painter and decorator. The cost: quality swings in delegated stages are underwritten by the master's name; a disciple's slip is a 'Wu Daozi' slip; and stages long unexecuted dull one's own hand. Modern analogues: the architect drawing concepts while the firm does construction documents, lead authors and co-writers, the 'creator plus execution team' structure across creative industries.
modes.source_chapter: 张彦远《历代名画记》记翟琙、张藏为吴道子布色；『立笔挥扫，势若风旋』
modes.key_quote_zh: 立笔挥扫，势若风旋，而敷彩付弟子——把神助般的笔留给线，把可规格化的工序交出去。
modes.key_quote_en: The brush sweeps like a whirlwind, the colors are left to disciples—reserve the spirit-aided brush for the line; hand off what can be specified.
process_zh: 列环节清单：把创作全过程拆为环节，逐一判定『判断密度』——哪里需要全神，哪里可规格化
锁定核心：为自己只保留判断密度最高的环节（骨线/构图/关键决策），并宣布其余可让渡
定义交接界面：给让渡环节写下明确的规范（色不许越线、微染层次、验收标准），让执行者有法可依
以名兜底验收：弟子成稿必须过大师的终审，让渡的风险用验收程序对冲而非听天由命
process_en: List the stages: break creation into stages and grade each by 'judgment density'—where full spirit is required, where it can be specified
Lock the core: keep for yourself only the highest-judgment stages (bone-line, composition, key decisions) and declare the rest delegable
Define the handoff interface: write explicit spec for delegated stages—color never crosses the line, wash layers, acceptance criteria—so executors have law to follow
Acceptance under the name: disciples' work must pass the master's final review; hedge delegated risk with procedure, not hope
representative_cases_zh: 长安、洛阳两京寺院三百余间壁画的巨量工程：没有环节拆分 physically 不可能——分工体系是『画圣』产量的真实底座
张藏『经岁落成』的记录：执行环节有自己的时间律，与核心环节的一挥而就并行不悖——两种节奏被界面隔离
『吴家样』成为北宋武宗元一代画工传习的范本：样式可传承证明拆分界面定义得足够清晰
反例警示：全环节亲力亲为者产量即寿命，作品再精也是绝响；而完全外包核心判断的工作室，产量再有也只是贴牌
representative_cases_en: Three hundred-plus temple walls across the two capitals: physically impossible without stage-splitting—the division of labor is the real foundation of the 'Sage of Painting's' output
Zhang Cang 'completing a figure over a year': the execution stage keeps its own tempo, coexisting with the core's single-flash—two rhythms isolated by the interface
The 'Wu manner' as the template for Northern Song painters under Wu Zongyuan: an inheritable style proves the interface was defined clearly enough
Counter-case: the artist who does everything personally has output equal to lifespan—a masterpiece but an extinction; the studio that outsources the core judgment has output but only a label
modern_applications_zh: 创作者经济：明确自己的『不可让渡环节』（观点/品味/关键笔），把剪辑、排版、运营等规格化环节交给工具或团队
技术架构：首席工程师只写最难的那 10% 核心代码与接口定义，其余交给团队按规范执行——让渡界面是架构文档
知识产品化：把个人方法论整理成可传承的『样』（模板/规范/检查表），让团队产出的东西仍带有你的判断密度
管理分工：领导者只保留判断密度最高的人事与方向决策，可规格化的运营全部制度化下放
modern_applications_en: Creator economy: name your non-delegable stage (viewpoint, taste, the decisive stroke); hand editing, layout and operations to tools or teams
Engineering: the principal engineer writes only the hardest 10%—core code and interface definitions; the team executes to spec—the handoff interface is the architecture doc
Productizing knowledge: turn personal methodology into an inheritable 'manner'—templates, specs, checklists—so team output still carries your judgment density
Management: leaders keep only the highest-judgment calls—people and direction; institutionalize and delegate everything specifiable

modes.domain_zh: 把个人笔法沉淀为可传承、可复制、可教学的『吴家样』——不同寺壁、不同题材、不同助手手中长出的都是同一血统的画；个人风格升格为生产体系，让风格在规模中存活而非在孤本中完美
modes.domain_en: Precipitate personal brushwork into an inheritable, replicable, teachable 'Wu manner'—walls, subjects and assistants all differ, yet the lineage of the painting is one; personal style is promoted into a production system, letting style survive scale rather than perish perfect in a single sheet
modes.definition_zh: 『吴家样』与曹家样、张家样、周家样并列为画史四大家样。方法论内核有三：其一，风格必须被对象化为可教学的形式——吴道子不满足于『我会画』，而是把兰叶描的提按规律、经变人物的组合程式、鬼神力士的造型规范整理成弟子可习得的样式；风格从手腕转移到可传授的规范，才获得了不随肉身死亡的寿命。其二，样式是生成器不是复印机——『样』规定的是参数空间（线的宽窄律、衣纹的组织法、开脸的程式），每一堵新壁在此参数空间内重新生成，所以三百间寺院的壁画千变万化而又一眼可辨为吴家血统。其三，体系化以牺牲独占为代价换不朽——样式一旦公开，伪作与平庸模仿必然泛滥；吴道子选择的不是独占而是血统：宁要一个庞大而良莠不齐的后代，不要一件完美而断绝的孤品。深意在于：个人天赋的最优归宿是成为体系——被记住的不是某一堵壁画，而是让三百堵壁画成为可能的那个生成规则。代价是：程式化会反噬原创力，晚年吴道子自己也在样式的引力下重复；且体系的信誉要求他持续为弟子的产出兜底。现代对应物是设计系统（design system）、 franchise 的世界观规范、以及一切『把品味变成可执行规范』的知识管理。
modes.definition_en: The 'Wu manner' stands beside the Cao, Zhang and Zhou manners as one of the four great styles of art history. Three cores. First, style must be objectified into teachable form: Wu did not rest at 'I can paint'—the pressure laws of the orchid-leaf stroke, the compositional programs of transformation tableaux, the modeling codes of spirits and warriors were organized into a style disciples could learn; only when style migrates from the wrist into transmissible spec does it gain a lifespan beyond the body. Second, the manner is a generator, not a photocopier: the 'yang' specifies a parameter space—laws of line thickness, organization of drapery, conventions of faces—and every new wall regenerates within it; hence three hundred temples, endlessly varied, yet identifiable at a glance as one lineage. Third, systematization trades monopoly for immortality: once published, forgeries and mediocre imitations necessarily flood in; Wu chose lineage over exclusivity—rather a vast posterity of mixed quality than a single perfect dead end. The deeper point: the best destiny of personal talent is to become a system—what is remembered is not one wall but the generating rule that made three hundred possible. The cost: formula feeds back on originality—late Wu himself repeats under the manner's gravity; and the system's credit requires him to keep underwriting his disciples' output. Modern analogues: design systems, franchise world-bibles, every act of knowledge management that turns taste into executable spec.
modes.source_chapter: 郭若虚《图画见闻志》论曹吴体法；『吴家样』与曹、张、周家样并称；两京寺观壁画体系
modes.key_quote_zh: 宁要一个庞大而良莠不齐的画派血统，不要一件完美而断绝的孤品——把风格做成生成器。
modes.key_quote_en: Rather a vast, uneven lineage than one perfect dead end—make the style a generator, not a museum piece.
process_zh: 提炼参数：从个人最佳实践中抽出可命名的规律（线律/形律/色律），把『手感』翻译成『规范』
写成可教形式：以粉本、口诀、示范把规范固化为弟子可习得的教材，并公开授受
留出生成空间：规范只锁参数空间的关键轴，允许每件新作品在空间内自由生成变体
以血统维护信誉：为体系产出建立终审与命名（样）制度，让模仿者共享血统也共享责任
process_en: Extract parameters: name the laws inside your best practice—line, form, color—and translate 'feel' into 'spec'
Fix it teachable: solidify the spec into drafts, formulas and demonstrations that disciples can learn; teach it openly
Leave generative room: the spec locks only key axes of the parameter space, letting every new work generate its own variants within it
Underwrite the lineage: build final review and naming ('manner') for the system's output, so imitators share the bloodline and the accountability
representative_cases_zh: 两京三百余间寺观壁画与大量 simultaneously 训练的弟子：吴家样是艺术史上第一个真正意义上的『规模化风格生产体系』
北宋武宗元《朝元仙仗图》直承吴样而自成规模——体系的第二、三代仍能产出杰作，证明参数空间设计成功
『吴带当风』成为跨画科的通用术语：从人物画渗入雕塑与壁画论，说明样式已被抽象为行业语言
反例警示：只留作品不留规范的大家，身后即遭仿冒淹没而真意失传——孤本的天才是艺术品的天才，不是体系的天才
representative_cases_en: Three hundred temple walls across the capitals alongside a crowd of simultaneously trained disciples: the Wu manner is art history's first true 'scaled style-production system'
Wu Zongyuan's Procession of Immortals in the Northern Song, direct heir of the manner yet its own achievement: a second generation producing masterpieces proves the parameter space was well designed
'Wu's sashes in wind' leaking beyond figure painting into sculpture and mural theory: the manner abstracted into the industry's language
Counter-case: masters who leave works but no spec are drowned in forgeries after death, the true intent lost—the genius of the unique sheet is the genius of an artwork, not of a system
modern_applications_zh: 设计系统建设：把个人设计决策沉淀为 token、组件与使用规范，让团队规模不稀释品味
内容矩阵：个人 IP 拆解为可复用的栏目模板与选题参数空间，多账号多平台规模化而不失血统
开源与标准：把核心方法论写成公开规范（RFC/风格指南），接受生态模仿以换取行业标准的地位
企业知识管理：明星员工的隐性经验强制『参数化』入库，人走经验留
modern_applications_en: Design systems: precipitate personal design decisions into tokens, components and usage spec, so scale never dilutes taste
Content matrices: break a personal IP into reusable formats and a topic parameter space—many accounts, many platforms, one bloodline
Open source and standards: publish your core methodology as an open spec (RFC, style guide); accept ecosystem imitation in exchange for becoming the industry standard
Corporate knowledge: force star employees' tacit experience into parameterized repositories—when people leave, the experience stays

modes.domain_zh: 在景公寺画《地狱变相》『笔力劲怒，变状阴怪』，使『京都屠沽渔罟之辈见之而惧罪改业』——不画一个说教文字，纯以视觉恐惧重塑一座城市的行业伦理；用图像的生理冲击完成道德的公共治理
modes.domain_en: His Transformation of Hell at Jinggong Temple, 'brush-force stern and wrathful, the states of torment darkly strange,' made 'the butchers, fishers and netters of the capital see it and fear sin, changing their trades'—not one word of preaching, purely visual fear reshaping a city's trade ethics; image as physiological shock accomplishing moral public governance
modes.definition_zh: 《唐朝名画录》与《太平广记》皆记：吴道子画《地狱变相》后，两京屠沽渔罟之流『见之而惧罪改业』者众，市沽因此或歇业。方法论内核有三：其一，选择受众的心理杠杆而非信息量——屠夫渔户未必识字，经卷讲经到达率有限；而地狱图像绕过文字直接命中恐惧中枢，视觉的到达率与穿透力远胜文本。其二，恐惧的投放对象是行为不是观点——作品不求观众『认同地狱存在』的教义辩论，只求『今日收刀改行』的行为改变；劝诫的成功标准被定义为可观察的行业人口迁移。其三，把公共空间当作媒介——寺院壁画是唐代最高流量的公共媒介，吴道子把最重的伦理议题投放在人流最大的墙上，媒介选择本身就是策略。深意在于：最高效的说服不增加任何信息，只改变既有信息的呈现通道与强度——让现存的教义（因果）通过视觉放大器变成生理级体验。代价是：恐惧媒介的伦理边界模糊，过度的阴怪可能沦为猎奇；且行为改变若无制度承接，热度退后回潮。现代对应物是公共卫生的警示图像、安全教育的实感体验、以及一切『用呈现通道的升级替代信息增量』的传播设计。
modes.definition_en: Both the Annals of Famous Painters of the Tang and the Taiping Guangji record that after Wu painted the Transformation of Hell, many among the butchers and fishers of the two capitals 'saw it and, fearing sin, changed their trades'; some markets reportedly closed. Three cores. First, choose the audience's psychological lever, not information volume: butchers and fishermen may not read, and scripture lectures have limited reach; the image of hell bypasses text and strikes the fear center directly—visual penetration far exceeds the textual. Second, fear targets behavior, not opinion: the work does not seek doctrinal assent ('hell exists') but observable conduct ('put down the knife today'); the success metric of moral art is defined as migration of trade populations. Third, treat public space as medium: temple walls were the Tang's highest-traffic public medium, and Wu placed the heaviest ethical subject on the busiest walls—the choice of medium is itself the strategy. The deeper point: the most efficient persuasion adds no information, only upgrades the channel and intensity of existing information—making existing doctrine (karma) into a physiological experience through a visual amplifier. The cost: fear-media's ethical border is blurry; excess grotesquerie slides into spectacle; and behavior change without institutional follow-up relapses. Modern analogues: public-health warning imagery, visceral safety training, every communication design that upgrades the channel of presentation instead of adding information.
modes.source_chapter: 朱景玄《唐朝名画录》景公寺《地狱变相》；『京都屠沽渔罟之辈见之而惧罪改业』（亦见《太平广记》引《两京耆旧传》）
modes.key_quote_zh: 屠沽渔罟见之惧罪改业——一个字没写，一座城改了行。
modes.key_quote_en: Butchers and fishers saw it, feared sin, and changed their trades—not one word written, and a city changed its livelihood.
process_zh: 锁定行为目标：先写清楚要改变的具体行为（谁、做什么、改成什么），而非要传达的观点
选心理杠杆：按目标受众的认知条件（识字率/日常焦虑/既有信仰）选择最强的直达通道
投放到流量口：把作品放进目标人群无法绕开的公共空间，让观看成为被动发生的日常事件
建立承接制度：为被触动者准备出口（改行的路径/求助的通道），让情绪冲击有地方落地
process_en: Lock the behavioral target: first write down the specific conduct to change—who does what, into what—not the opinion to convey
Choose the psychological lever: per the audience's cognitive conditions—literacy, daily anxieties, existing beliefs—pick the strongest direct channel
Deploy at the traffic point: place the work in public space the target cannot avoid, so viewing happens passively, as daily event
Build the outlet institution: prepare exits for the moved—paths to change trades, channels to seek help—so the emotional shock has somewhere to land
representative_cases_zh: 景公寺《地狱变相》致两京屠沽改业、市面歇业：中国艺术史上唯一一次被正史笔法记载的『一幅画改变城市就业结构』事件
『变状阴怪』而观众对象是普通市民：把精英伦理（佛教因果）翻译成市井生理反应，完成了教义的跨阶层传播
吴道子未画文字榜题记载于本事的叙述重心：故事记住的是图像的效果而不是任何题记——视觉 autonomous 的最早证明之一
反例警示：恐惧策略若无出口配套，只制造焦虑与麻木；后世模仿『阴怪』者流于猎奇装饰，行为改变力归零
representative_cases_en: The Transformation of Hell at Jinggong Temple moving the butchers and fishers of two capitals to quit their trades: the only event in Chinese art history recorded, in quasi-official style, as 'one painting changing a city's employment structure'
'States darkly strange' aimed at ordinary townsfolk: elite ethics (karma) translated into street-level physiology—cross-class transmission of doctrine completed
The sources remember the image's effect and quote no inscription: among the earliest proofs of the image's autonomy from text
Counter-case: fear strategy without institutional outlets manufactures only anxiety and numbness; later imitators of the 'darkly strange' sink into spectacle, conduct-change power at zero
modern_applications_zh: 公共卫生传播：烟盒图形警示、事故现场实感教育——为每一类行为风险配一条视觉级通道，并接住改行/求助的出口
产品设计：让危险操作的后果可视化（删除前的数据丢失预览），用『看见损失』替代『阅读警告』
品牌公益：把抽象议题（碳排放/塑料污染）转译为单一强图像事件，投放于目标人群的必经空间
组织治理：把违规后果做成可参观的案例现场（安全教育的警示墙），制度承接上配申诉与补救通道
modern_applications_en: Public health: graphic warnings on packaging, visceral accident education—pair every behavioral risk with a visual-grade channel and a real exit
Product design: visualize consequences of destructive actions (data-loss preview before delete); 'see the loss' instead of 'read the warning'
Cause campaigns: translate abstract issues—carbon, plastic—into one strong image-event, placed where the target audience must pass
Organizational governance: turn violation consequences into visitable case sites (safety warning walls), with appeals and remedies as institutional follow-up

modes.domain_zh: 一生壁画无数而无一纸传世真迹、无一枚落款印章——他把署名的必要性整个消解在『样式即署名』里：天下人认笔不认名，吴家样本身就是那枚盖在三百家寺院墙上的印
modes.domain_en: A lifetime of countless murals, yet not one authenticated scroll, not one seal of signature—his entire strategy dissolves the necessity of signing into 'the manner is the signature': the world recognized the brush, not the name; the Wu manner itself is the seal stamped on three hundred temple walls
modes.definition_zh: 画史确认吴道子无可靠纸本真迹存世，传世皆宋人摹本或粉本；《历代名画记》记其壁画多为受请而作、随成随散于公共空间。方法论内核有三：其一，把署名从落款升格为笔迹学——在无法署名的公共壁画上，笔法本身就是身份系统；鉴定传统（『此有吴生之笔』）以笔性而非印章立论，说明他成功把个人识别度注入了不可复制的层面。其二，公共作品的最大化署名是场所记忆——长安人记不住某个款识，但记得住『平康坊那面地狱壁』；作品与城市空间绑定后，署名由纸面符号变为地点传说，传播深度反超任何印章。其三，拒纸本是对通胀的防御——纸本可伪造、可流转、可炒卖，而壁画不可移动；不提供可伪造载体，反而让『真吴生』的稀缺性由整个城市的公共记忆共同维护。深意在于：署名的最高形态不是名字而是不可伪造的识别特征——当你的产出带有无法模仿的指纹，署名与否无关紧要；而当产出可被轻易复制时，签再多名也守不住。代价是：放弃纸本即放弃作品的绝对控制权与身后收益，真迹断绝全赖转述与摹本续命。现代对应物是开源作者的代码风格署名、無名氏设计与匿名品牌、以及一切『让作品自己证明血统』的署名策略。
modes.definition_en: Art history confirms no reliable paper original by Wu survives—what remains are Song copies and drafts; the murals were mostly made to request and dispersed into public space. Three cores. First, upgrade signature from inscription to graphology: on public walls one cannot sign, so brushwork itself becomes the identity system; the connoisseurship tradition argues from 'this has Master Wu's brush'—brush character, not seals—proof that he injected personal identifiability at a non-copyable layer. Second, the maximal signature of public work is place-memory: Chang'an could not remember an inscription but remembered 'the hell wall in Pingkang ward'; once the work binds to urban space, the signature becomes a place-legend, deeper than any seal. Third, refusing paper originals is defense against inflation: paper can be forged, traded, speculated; walls cannot move—by offering no forgeable carrier, the scarcity of 'a true Wu' is jointly maintained by a whole city's public memory. The deeper point: the highest form of signature is not a name but an unfakeable identifying feature—when your output carries an unclonable fingerprint, signing is irrelevant; when it can be copied at will, no number of signatures protects it. The cost: abandoning paper originals abandons absolute control and posthumous revenue; the lineage survives only through transmission and copies. Modern analogues: the open-source author's code-style signature, anonymous design houses, every strategy that lets the work prove its own lineage.
modes.source_chapter: 画史通说：吴道子无纸本真迹传世，今存皆摹本/传派；张彦远《历代名画记》记两京壁画与『吴生之笔』鉴定语
modes.key_quote_zh: 无一纸真迹，无一枚私印，而天下识吴笔——署名的最高形态是笔迹，不是名字。
modes.key_quote_en: Not one paper original, not one personal seal—yet the world knows the Wu brush: the highest signature is the stroke itself, not the name.
process_zh: 识别产出形态：判断自己的作品属于可署名载体（纸本/可流转）还是不可署名载体（公共/不可移动）
把身份注入笔迹层：在不可署名载体上，将个人识别度做进不可复制的执行细节（笔性/结构习惯/节奏）
绑定场所与社群：让作品与具体地点、共同体的记忆绑定，用空间替你保管署名
拒绝可伪造载体：克制把作品降格为可批量流转商品的冲动，用稀缺维护真迹的公信
process_en: Identify your medium's nature: is your work a signable carrier (paper, movable) or an un-signable one (public, immovable)?
Inject identity at the stroke layer: on un-signable carriers, build identifiability into non-copyable execution details—brush character, structural habits, rhythm
Bind to place and community: tie works to specific locations and communal memory; let space keep your signature for you
Refuse forgeable carriers: resist downgrading works into tradable commodities; scarcity maintains the credibility of the true
representative_cases_zh: 两京寺观壁画经会昌灭佛大半损毁，而『吴道子』之名反更加隆盛——署名寄存在城市记忆与文献转述中，比颜料更耐毁
鉴定传统以『吴带当风』『吴生之笔』立论：宋人判一幅画的归属看笔性看程式，不看款印——笔迹学身份系统建成
传世摹本（如《送子天王图》宋摹）反而扩大影响力：真迹断绝但样式不朽，摹本成为血统的信使
反例警示：过度依赖款印与证书的当代市场里，可伪造载体的鉴伪成本无限上升——署名越重，伪造激励越强
representative_cases_en: The Huichang persecution destroyed most of the two capitals' murals, yet 'Wu Daozi' the name grew ever greater—his signature lodged in urban memory and literary transmission, more durable than pigment
Connoisseurship arguing from 'Wu's sashes in wind' and 'the brush of Wu': Song judges looked to brush character and convention, not to seals—an identity system of graphology completed
Surviving Song copies (e.g., the Song copy of the Heavenly King scroll) expanded his influence: originals extinct, the manner immortal—copies as messengers of the bloodline
Counter-case: in today's market leaning on seals and certificates, authentication costs of forgeable carriers rise without bound—the heavier the signature, the stronger the incentive to forge
modern_applications_zh: 创作者匿名策略：以稳定到可辨识的输出风格替代个人品牌露脸，让『看一眼就知道是谁』成为护城河
开源署名：不追星标而追代码风格——把架构习惯做成团队一眼可辨的指纹
品牌防伪：把防伪资源从印鉴证书转移到不可复制的产品执行细节（工艺/手感/节奏感）上
组织知识署名：让核心方法论的执行痕迹（文档风格/评审口径）成为团队身份，人员流动不带走血统
modern_applications_en: Creator anonymity: replace face-branding with an instantly recognizable output style—'one glance and you know' as the moat
Open-source signature: chase code style, not stars—make architectural habits a fingerprint the team recognizes at sight
Brand anti-counterfeiting: move resources from seals and certificates to uncopyable execution details—craft, feel, rhythm
Organizational signature: let the execution traces of core methodology—doc style, review voice—be the team's identity; attrition cannot carry the bloodline away

modes.domain_zh: 生前即把身后布局做进人事：选翟琙、张藏承色，传卢楞伽、杨庭光承线，『卢楞伽……本自出己意』亦容之——用识别并容忍强个性弟子的方式，让吴家样在自己死后继续生长而不是随葬
modes.domain_en: He laid his afterlife plans in personnel decisions while alive: choosing Zhai Cong and Zhang Cang to carry color, Lu Lengqia and Yang Tingguang to carry line—tolerating even Lu's tendency to 'come from his own intent'—so that the Wu manner would keep growing after his death rather than be buried with him
modes.definition_zh: 《历代名画记》记吴道子弟子有翟琙、张藏、卢楞伽、杨庭光等：翟、张承布色之职；卢楞伽『细密』而『本自出己意』，杨庭光几可乱真而据说曾密写吴生。方法论内核有三：其一，传承是岗位设计不是感情安排——他按体系缺口配人：颜色缺口给翟张，线法缺口给卢杨，每个弟子对应体系的一个器官；死后体系的存续取决于器官是否都有人，而不是弟子是否最亲。其二，容忍『出己意』是传承的逆直觉条件——他没有要求弟子绝对忠实；卢楞伽带己意的细密化恰是样式在大唐腹地继续分叉变异的动力；一味复刻的传承会把活样式做成标本。其三，对『背叛性模仿』保持沉默的胸怀——杨庭光密写其画的记载流传而未见其发怒禁绝；血统的扩散优先于名下的垄断。深意在于：一个人的身后命运在他选择的人身上，而不在他的作品里——作品会被毁（会昌灭佛），但被他选中并赋权的人会继续做选择。代价是：授权弟子的变体可能稀释乃至改写正统，血统的纯度无法同时与血统的活性兼得。现代对应物是创始人的继任者设计、学派导师容忍弟子叛逆、以及开源项目维护者向强个性 committer 的交棒。
modes.definition_en: Record of Famous Painters lists disciples Zhai Cong, Zhang Cang, Lu Lengqia, Yang Tingguang: Zhai and Zhang carried the coloring office; Lu, 'fine and dense,' 'came from his own intent'; Yang could nearly pass for the master, said once to have secretly copied him. Three cores. First, succession is post design, not sentiment: he staffed by system gap—color gap to Zhai and Zhang, line gap to Lu and Yang, each disciple mapped to an organ of the system; survival after death depends on every organ having an owner, not on the disciple's affection. Second, tolerating 'their own intent' is the counter-intuitive condition of inheritance: he never demanded absolute fidelity; Lu's idiosyncratic fineness was precisely what let the manner keep branching and mutating deep in the empire; replica-only inheritance embalms a living style. Third, the magnanimity of silence toward 'traitorous imitation': the tale of Yang's secret copying circulated without any recorded ban; spread of the bloodline outranked monopoly of the name. The deeper point: one's afterlife lies in the people one chooses, not in one's works—works can be destroyed (the Huichang persecution), but the people chosen and empowered go on choosing. The cost: authorized variants may dilute, even rewrite, orthodoxy; purity and vitality of a bloodline cannot both be had. Modern analogues: a founder's succession design, the schoolmaster who tolerates the rebel disciple, the maintainer handing an open-source project to strong-willed committers.
modes.source_chapter: 张彦远《历代名画记》记吴道子弟子：翟琙、张藏、卢楞伽『本自出己意』、杨庭光等
modes.key_quote_zh: 作品会被火烧掉，被选中的人不会——把身后托付给人事，而不是托付给壁画。
modes.key_quote_en: Walls burn; the people you chose do not—entrust your afterlife to personnel, not to plaster.
process_zh: 盘点体系缺口：把自己的体系拆成器官（承色/承线/承论/承关系），逐一检查『我死后谁管这个』
按缺口选人：为每个缺口挑选能力匹配者，而非按亲疏排序；接受体系需要的缺点
授权并容忍变异：明确每个继承岗位的权限边界，同时容忍弟子在边界内的『出己意』
对扩散保持沉默：不禁止模仿与变体，用血统叙事而非法律手段维持体系认同
process_en: Inventory the system's organs: split your system into organs—color, line, doctrine, relationships—and check each: after me, who?
Staff by gap: pick for capability per gap, not by closeness; accept the flaws the system needs
Authorize and tolerate variation: set each succession post's boundary of authority, and within it tolerate the disciple's own intent
Stay silent toward spread: ban neither imitation nor variant; maintain system identity by narrative of lineage, not by legal force
representative_cases_zh: 翟琙、张藏承色，卢楞伽、杨庭光承线：吴家样在两京之外（如蜀地卢楞伽画迹）继续落地——体系器官在地理上也被冗余部署
卢楞伽『本自出己意』被史笔如实记录而非贬斥：唐代画史为『忠诚的变异』保留了正面档案
会昌灭佛摧毁了大部分壁画实物，而吴派样式经武宗元至北宋仍为官方画院范本——人事传承比作品实体更耐毁
反例警示：只传亲随、不容变异的作坊，一代而亡；把体系托付给纯复刻者，等于给活物做标本
representative_cases_en: Zhai and Zhang carrying color, Lu and Yang carrying line: the Wu manner landed beyond the capitals too (Lu's work in Shu)—organs redundantly deployed across geography
Lu Lengqia's 'own intent' recorded as fact, not censure: Tang art history kept a positive archive for 'faithful variation'
The Huichang persecution burned most wall-actualia, yet the manner remained the official academy's template through Wu Zongyuan in the Northern Song—personnel outlasting plaster
Counter-case: the workshop that transmits only to kin and tolerates no variation dies in one generation; entrusting a system to pure replicators is taxidermy of a living thing
modern_applications_zh: 创始人继任设计：把公司拆成器官（产品/文化/关系/现金），每个器官指定非亲属的 owner，并在任内容忍其变异
学派与团队传承：导师公开为『带己意』的高徒背书，把叛离定义成体系的分叉而非背叛
开源交棒：向强个性 committer 移交维护权，用治理文档而非人情约束边界
家庭与财富传承：把『价值观器官』托付给最能执行它的人，而非默认托付给血缘最近的人
modern_applications_en: Founder succession: split the company into organs—product, culture, relationships, cash—name a non-kin owner for each, and tolerate their variation in office
School and team inheritance: publicly endorse the best disciple 'with their own intent'; define defection as the system's branching, not betrayal
Open-source handover: transfer maintenance to strong-willed committers; bound it with governance docs, not favors
Family and wealth succession: entrust the organ of values to whoever can best execute them, not by default to the nearest blood
